earnings.title: ServiceNow Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Total revenues of $4,106 million in Q3 2026, representing 20.5% year-over-year growth, 20% in constant currency
Subscription revenues of $3,988 million in Q3 2026, representing 21% year-over-year growth, 20.5% in constant currency

As of September 30, 2026, current remaining performance obligations (“cRPO”), contract revenue that will be recognized as revenue in the next 12 months, was $13.65 billion, representing 20.5% year-over-year growth and 21% in constant currenc y.

quotes.text: This was more than another beat-and-raise quarter for ServiceNow, this was the inflection point for ServiceNow as the Super Intelligence Control Tower.
quotes.by: ServiceNow Chairman and CEO Bill McDermott

quotes.text: Our strong Q3 results reinforce how ServiceNow is perfectly positioned to help customers put AI to work across their business, govern every agent and action, and translate intelligence into secure, measurable outcomes.
quotes.by: ServiceNow President and CFO Gina Mastantuono

items.heading: This summary provides an overview of the risks we face and should not be considered a substitute for the more fulsome risk factors discussed immediately following this summary.
Laws, regulations and customer expectations regarding the use, storage and movement of data may restrict our ability to continue to optimize our platform.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Ability to Grow Our Business

items.heading: A failure to innovate and adapt how we offer our products in response to rapidly evolving technological changes and in the midst of an intensely competitive market may harm our competitive position and business prospects.
We may not successfully increase our penetration of international markets or manage risks associated with foreign markets.
Incorporating AI technology into our offerings may result in operational, legal, regulatory, ethical and other challenges.
We rely on our network of partners for an increasing portion of our revenues, and if these partners fail to perform, our business may be harmed.
